problem_solved: Sustainable recycling of coconut leaf biomass
description: Kalpa Organic Gold is a granular organic manure produced by converting lignin-rich coconut leaves into vermicompost using the earthworm Eudrilus sp. (African nightcrawler). The resulting vermicompost can be applied to a wide range of field and horticultural crops
applications:
Organic fertilizer and bio-input manufacturers
Coconut plantations and integrated farming enterprises
Horticulture and commercial crop growers
Sustainable agriculture and organic farming initiatives
Agricultural cooperatives and farmer producer organizations (FPOs)
